Questions 7-13 
 
Complete the notes below. 
 
Choose ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER from the passage for each answer. 
 
 
                                  New Zealand's kākāpō 
 
A type of parrot: 
 
● diet consists of fern fronds, various parts of a tree and 7 ……………. 
 
● nests are created 8 ……………. in where eggs are laid. 
 
Arrival of Polynesian settlers 
 
● the 9 ……………. of the käkäpö were used to make clothes. 
 
Arrival of European colonisers 
 
● 10 ……………. were an animal which they introduced that ate the 
käkäpö's food sources. 
 
Protecting kākāpō 
 
● Richard Henry, a conservationist, tried to protect the kākāpō. 
 
● a definite sighting of female käkāpō on Rakiura Island was reported in 
the year 11 ……………. 
 
● the Recovery Plan included an increase in 12 ……………. 
 
● a current goal of the Recovery Plan is to maintain the involvement of 13 
……………. in kākāpō protection.
